name: skipped_outcome_routes_like_success
workflow:
digraph T {
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  a [prompt="x"]
  b [prompt="x"]
  start -> a
  a -> b [condition="outcome=skipped"]
  a -> exit
  b -> exit

}
departure: Fabro records no stage for a skipped outcome, so its path omits `a`; Petri records every final outcome, `skipped` included. The routing (an `outcome=skipped` edge is taken) is the same.
